topic: Dockerizing Java and Spring Boot Applications
learningObjectives: Explain how containers package Java applications with their runtime requirements.
Identify the major instructions in a Java Dockerfile.
Construct a containerization workflow for a Spring Boot application.

activities.title: Container Architecture
activities.instruction: Explore the parts of a containerized application.

content.concept: A container packages an application and its required runtime environment into an isolated, portable execution unit.
